blocks.html: 31ft Premium Center Console – Private Fishing Charter in San José del Cabo

#6 31ft Premium Center Console – Private Fishing Charter for 1–5 Guests | Contact Us for Pricing

Discover our 31ft Premium Center Console, a private fishing charter option for couples, families, and small groups visiting San José del Cabo.

This 31-foot premium center console offers a spacious fishing platform with open deck space, comfortable seating, a shaded T-top, and an onboard toilet. Its twin-engine design and fishing equipment make it suitable for guests looking to combine offshore sportfishing with comfort and performance.

Whether you're an experienced angler or enjoying your first fishing adventure, this boat offers opportunities to target seasonal species such as yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo, and marlin when conditions allow.

Depending on weather, sea conditions, and seasonal fish activity, your captain may recommend fishing grounds such as Gordo Banks, Iman Bank, or other suitable areas around San José del Cabo.

Every private charter includes an experienced local captain and crew, fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle. Fishing licenses, live bait, food, drinks, transportation, and fish-cleaning services vary by charter and must be confirmed before booking.
